contracts.cursor:
{
  "version": 2,
  "harness": "cursor",
  "skill": "cursor-harness-handoff",
  "generated_by": "scripts/build_skills.py",
  "generated_from": "skills-src/contracts.json",
  "binary": "cursor-agent",
  "prompt_delivery": "argv_last",
  "prompt_file_flag": null,
  "parser": "json_object",
  "sdk": {
    "kind": "library",
    "status": "stable",
    "languages": [
      "typescript",
      "python"
    ],
    "packages": {
      "typescript": "@cursor/sdk",
      "python": "cursor-sdk"
    },
    "entrypoints": {
      "typescript": "Agent",
      "python": "Agent"
    },
    "command": null,
    "repositories": {
      "typescript": "https://github.com/cursor/cursor",
      "python": "https://github.com/cursor/cursor"
    },
    "docs": "https://cursor.com/docs/sdk/typescript",
    "runtimes": {
      "typescript": "node>=22.13",
      "python": "python>=3.10"
    },
    "session": "cursor-agent",
    "ownership": "mixed",
    "surface": "mixed",
    "fresh": "sdk-or-cli",
    "continuation": "sdk-or-cli",
    "history": "sdk",
    "history_scope": "either",
    "continuation_scope": "either",
    "stream": "sdk-events",
    "id_namespaces": [
      "cli-chat",
      "sdk-local-agent",
      "sdk-cloud-agent",
      "editor-session"
    ],
    "forbidden_operations": [
      "team-admin-key-for-sdk",
      "editor-takeover",
      "newest-as-exact"
    ],
    "auth_channel": "api-key",
    "auth": "mixed",
    "auth_notes": "Use a user or service-account API key supplied as CURSOR_API_KEY or per-call configuration. Team Admin API keys are unsupported. Local CLI, SDK local/cloud, editor, and cloud IDs are separate namespaces.",
    "approval_notes": "Apply sandbox, workspace trust, tool allowlists, and approval controls explicitly for the selected local or cloud runtime. CLI chat continuation does not prove delivery into a busy editor agent.",
    "evidence": {
      "docs_checked": true,
      "registry_checked": true,
      "cli_present": true,
      "sdk_smoke_passed": false
    }
  },
  "model_from_route": true,
  "discovery_argv": [
    "models"
  ],
  "call_workdir": false,
  "task_config_strategy": "cursor_sandbox_enabled",
  "oneshot_argv": [
    "--workspace",
    "<workspace>",
    "--sandbox",
    "enabled",
    "--print",
    "--output-format",
    "json",
    "--model",
    "<model>",
    "<prompt>"
  ],
  "interactivity": "prompts",
  "credential_channel": "native-session",
  "credential_auth": "native-session",
  "references": [
    "references/history-and-continuation.md"
  ],
  "advisory_vocabulary": {
    "status": [
      "started",
      "milestone",
      "blocked",
      "done"
    ],
    "fan_out": [
      "blocked",
      "done"
    ],
    "semantics": "self-reported presence, never proof of completion; carries no control state and never blocks the lane",
    "implemented_by": "work-coordination"
  },
  "adapter": "harness_fleet/providers/cursor.py"
}
